notes.text: rows contains IMS-only primary-model evidence. supplementaryRows contains Career Launcher 2023 archive evidence and must not be mixed into the IMS forecast. QA order: Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Numbers, Modern Math. VARC order: RC, summary, sentence placement/paragraph completion, odd sentence, parajumbles. Sections: VARC, DILR, QA. DILR entries are question counts per set. Retrieved 2026-09-08.

These are provider-reported broad-topic totals, not official CAT topic tags or a question-level recount. Career Launcher often includes logarithms, functions and sequences/series in Algebra; IMS classifies some of these under Modern Math. Supplementary Career Launcher rows may populate clearly labelled archive tables but are excluded from the IMS training/backtest dataset.

No complete original IMS QA vector for CAT 2023 was verified. Preserve the 2023 gap in the primary timeline. IMS 2024 Slot 3 remains excluded because the Modern Math cell is blank. Do not interpolate missing years or infer the blank category from a total.

The QA total cells show Arithmetic 9 and Algebra 8, but the individually listed subtopic counts add to 8 and 7 respectively. The page's top QA TITA count is 7 while its QA narrative says 6. The row retains only the explicit broad-topic total cells; TITA counts have not been imported.

The 2023 IMS archive reports 8 DILR TITAs, whereas the Career Launcher 2023 pages report 6. This file deliberately omits section MCQ/TITA splits instead of resolving that discrepancy without a question-level audit. The 2024 Slot 2 providers also assign different set sizes to particular named DILR sets, although both give the same overall multiset [5,5,4,4,4]. Avoid importing topic-to-set-size mappings across providers.

The overall table leaves Slot 3 Modern Math blank. It was not filled by subtracting other counts from 22, borrowing Slot 1, or substituting another provider's count. Blog and root Slot 3 endpoints were unavailable to direct web access.

Despite the 2024 string in its URL, the archive title and repeated section headings explicitly describe CAT 2023. Both browser extraction and a direct HTML read found only broad structure; the Detailed Overall Analysis anchor has no href and the slot headings are accordion buttons, not links to detailed QA tables. All three guessed /blog/cat/cat-2023-slot-N-analysis/ and /cat-2023-slot-N-analysis/ URLs returned 410 Gone through web access. Secondary reproductions were not treated as original IMS evidence.
